title: Raven grouping planner output
description: Strict structured output contract for the code-aware grouping step (Swarm triage or an external categorization session). The deterministic controller must validate this before any remediation is launched (see validate_groups.py).

repository.description: owner/repo this plan applies to. Groups must never cross repositories.

avids.description: Every constituent AVID. Each input AVID must appear in exactly one group, or in ungrouped_avids, or in duplicates.

shared_root_cause.description: The underlying defect that makes these AVIDs one coherent fix.

reported_locations.description: Scanner-reported locations (raw facts, preserved separately from predictions).

expected_files_to_change.description: Prediction of the actual change set. Used by the controller for conflict detection and serialization; scored against the real PR diff in the pilot.

ungrouped_avids.description: AVIDs deliberately left as their own single-AVID remediation units, or deferred (e.g. found already mitigated/unreachable — in that case they should carry a disposition upstream, not silently vanish).

duplicate_of.description: The AVID (member of a group or ungrouped) this record duplicates.

duplicates.description: Explicit duplicate relationships. The only sanctioned way for one AVID to map to another's remediation.
